worldcombat.skill.eerieimpulse.summary: Radiate an invisible eerie impulse from your body, spreading a ring of weird waves out to your own radius. Everything caught in it has its Sp. Atk scrambled. It aims at no one and needs no line of sight, only proximity; overloading widens and lengthens the field but slows the cast and raises the cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.eerieimpulse.use.0: Scramble every special attacker around you when they close in
worldcombat.skill.eerieimpulse.use.1: Cut a whole ring of Sp. Atk without aiming in a melee
worldcombat.skill.eerieimpulse.use.2: Win the first exchange so anyone who closes cannot hit special
worldcombat.skill.eerieimpulse.descripti: Every enemy in the ring loses %1$s stages of Sp. Atk and stays scrambled for about %2$s.
The field spreads %1$s blocks from the caster; no aiming and no line of sight are needed.
worldcombat.skill.eerieimpulse.timing: Range %1$s blocks, telegraph %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.eerieimpulse.preferenc: Off (steady): faster to discharge and a shorter cooldown, with the base radius and scramble. On (overload): dump all the charge at once, radius about x1.25 and scramble about x1.25, but +3 ticks of telegraph and +25 ticks of cooldown. A wider, longer field for a longer stand-and-wait.
Only consider the field when a threat is within this distance; smaller keeps it to grappling range, larger chases in first.
Only discharge when at least this many visible, hostile enemies stand within the field; larger reserves it for being surrounded, set 1 to fire on sight.
On: the companion will leave a hold position to discharge the field.
